question: Through whose grace has the determination of the Kaula doctrine been understood?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Knowledge arose by that lord's grace
The object known is the Kaula determination
inference: By the grace of the lord of Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have understood the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
